newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products up but gas oil barge premiums off.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products up but gas oil barge premiums off.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed on Monday morning, although weakening of heating oil barge premiums ahead of the expiry of May IPE futures wiped out most of the gains, dealers said.
Heating oil barges were offered at May IPE +50 cents and bid below screen. May IPE futures, which expire at 1100 GMT today, were up almost $1 a tonne.

Physical traders said the published delivery volume against the screen was not likely to be high after a number of exchange for physical (EFPs) deals had been concluded, notably between two large traders. Such EFPs, they said, would be likely to total more than 500,000 tonnes.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were offered $1 a tonne firmer than on Friday at $87/$87.50 fob Rotterdam. Buyers were $1 below.
